paint_geometry.fact: The first inventory-specific draw call is the shared gauge/bar component 0x004179B0 (not a frame blit): args are (x = window.x+0xF8, y = window.y-0xA5, value = [this+0x58], max = 0x5E = 94). 0x5E is the gauge fill scale (max), NOT a GameInter frame id. The gauge member is this+0x278, constructed at 0x0042EB4B with (GameInter selector edi, frame 0x118 = 280, arg3 = 6, w = 0xC = 12, h = 0xDA = 218, pad = 0xC = 12, mode = 0 = vertical). GameInter.wil frame 280 is a 16x424 vertical bar sprite. The fill ratio is value/(max-1); the fill field [this+0x58] is only ever zeroed in the reset virtual 0x0042E970 (no other static write exists in .text), so the bar renders empty in this build. Draw internals: ratio float stored [gauge+0xC]; frame sprite dims read from selector->[+0x38]; RECTs built through USER32 SetRect IAT slot [0x4762B0] (import name record at VA 0x4793D8, hint 0x0244 - not a code function); fill image drawn by 0x0045F2D0 (class 0x8AB7A8, clip rect); ftol via 0x468520. Ctor stores USER32 PtInRect IAT slot [0x47630C] (name record VA 0x4797DE, hint 0x01EA) at gauge+0x44 for hit testing. The 28x26 GameInter frame 94 image belongs to the unrelated HUD party button (layout.json hud.party, ctor 0x00427A82).
A later item/record draw path computes a horizontal coordinate x+0x19 plus an index multiplied by 36 pixels.
The corresponding vertical coordinate is y+0x29 plus a row/record difference multiplied by 36 pixels.

The selected item path builds source and destination rectangles, converts their integer extents through shared float helper 0x00466800, and composites with context 0x005600FC via 0x004542F0. This is the original item-icon/selection pipeline; it is not a plain 36px CSS slot fill.

The primary numeric text reads runtime value 0x007DA100 (read at 0x42EE4C) and formats it with VA 0x0047A214 ('%d') via sprintf helper 0x0046811C (ecx=0x8AB7A8); font set via 0x45DBA0 with name 0x47BE18 ('굴림체' Gulim, size 0xA=10); drawn via 0x45DE50 text-rect into (window.x+0x41, window.y+0x11A) to (window.x+0x8E, window.y+0x12B), color 0x64C8F8. This block (0x42EE36-0x42EEBE) executes BEFORE the this+0x54 mode dispatch, so the value box is drawn in ALL four modes. 0x7DA100 is never written anywhere in .text (exactly two imm32 reads: 0x41729D and 0x42EE4C), bss zero in this build, so the drawn value is 0 (see content_field_draw_mapping.primary_value).

The secondary text path reads 0x007DA11D (负重 word) and 0x007DA11F (总量 word) and formats them with 0x0047BDFC = "负重:%d / 总量:%d" (imm32 refs at 0x42EFA1/0x42EFB5; string 0x47BDFC is LIVE - single imm32 ref 0x42EFBF; colors 0xA0A0A then 0xF8C8C8); drawn at (x+0x86..x+0xF0, y+0x18..y+0x26). IMPORTANT: this 负重/总量 block belongs to the MODE-0 branch only (0x42EF8F-0x42F029; the mode-0 label [包袱] 0x47BE10 is drawn at 0x42EF5B color 0xF8DCFA, then falls through; mode 0 jumps to the shared end 0x42F123 at 0x42F029). The byte this+0x54 mode dispatch (jump table 0x42F13C) selects one of four label branches: case 0 -> 0x47BE10 "[包袱]" (0x42EF52 branch, 0xF8DCFA), case 1 -> 0x47BDF4 "[修补]" (0x42F02E branch, 0xF8C8C8), case 2 -> 0x47BDEC "[变卖]" (0x42F068 branch, 0xF8C8C8), case 3 -> 0x47BDE4 "[储存]" (0x42F0EB branch, 0xF8C8C8; corrected from the earlier wrong [木柴] reading - 木柴 is absent from the binary). Shared end 0x42F123/0x42F12F.
The selected-item branch is gated by globals 0x007DA1C0/0x007DA1C4 and 0x007243D8; it calls the inventory hit/index helpers before building the selected source/destination rectangles.
The inventory hit-test/search loop scans both axes in 36-pixel steps from 0 through 180, proving a 6-column by 6-row, 36-slot grid.
The item index is divided by 6; remainder selects the column and quotient selects the row. Slot rectangles are (window.x+0x19+36*column, window.y+0x29+36*row) with 36x36 size.
The three child controls are repositioned from the window origin with fixed offsets (0xF9,0x120), (0xB0,0x106), and (0xB0,0x11E) as shown by 0x00417830 calls.

Grid draw: cell identity table at this+0x2C4 holds one WORD per cell (6 cells/row, row stride 12 bytes); occupied cells have word >= 0x3E8 (1000), slot = word - 0x3E8 (movsx; cmp 0x3E8; jl skip; idiv 0x3E8 -> edx = slot). Rendered row window = max(0,[this+0x58]-5) .. [this+0x58]+6 (about 11 scrollable rows).

primary_value.semantic_status: candidate (closed static side 2026-08-11) - displayed LIVE in all four modes (block runs before the mode dispatch); bss zero in this build so the drawn value is 0. Also caps the dead outbound-0x405 trade-pay gate 0x417280 (qty > [0x7DA100] suppressed). Most defensible semantic: player gold/money on hand (金币/金钱) - the bag shows it as a plain %d box bottom-left and the trade-pay gate caps the paid amount at it; the older 'trade/buy quantity cap' reading stays compatible (cap = gold on hand). Runtime watch required to pin the exact value source.
primary_value.dead_code_proof: 0x7DA100 = head DWORD of a server/runtime-driven player-status block: whole range 0x7DA0E0-0x7DA1F0 is client-read-only (0x7DA0FC byte, 0x7DA100 DWORD, 0x7DA108 DWORD (9 refs: 0x429747/0x42A3D7/0x431571/0x431BAD/0x43279B/0x4339F2/0x433F97/0x44BD01/0x44E48A), 0x7DA109/0x10B/0x10F/0x111/0x113/0x115/0x119 words, 0x7DA11D 负重 WORD, 0x7DA11F 总量 WORD, 0x7DA121-0x7DA124 words, 0x7DA149-0x7DA157 stat words, 0x7DA1C0/0x7DA1C4 mouse, 0x7DA1D8; 33 refs each on the mouse words, 0 stores anywhere). 0x7DA100 itself: exactly TWO imm32 readers in all of .text - 0x41729D (outbound msg 0x405 gate 0x417280) and 0x42EE4C (this paint); ZERO writers (opcode-classified A3/89 modrm-05/C7 modrm-05 store scan: 0 stores). Gate 0x417280: cmp ax,0x405; jne ret; shr eax,16; test al,al; jne ret (byte2 must be 0); eax=atoi(arg2); cmp eax,[0x7DA100]; jg ret (value > cap suppresses); push eax; mov ecx,0x8AB828; call 0x451B00 (sends 0x405 with one value dword). Gate dead chain: sole E8 caller 0x42D6C6 = dispatcher 0x42D680 case byte2=3 (jump table 0x42D700 raw dwords [0x42D6BA,0x42D6D1,0x42D6F9,0x42D6A3,0x42D6F9,0x42D6F9,0x42D6E8] for byte2-3 in 0..6: byte2=3 -> 0x42D6BA -> gate with this=base+0x3399C; byte2=4 -> 0x425820 +0x4707C; byte2=6 -> 0x4247C0 +0x47834; byte2=9 -> 0x4404E0 +0x51150; CORRECTION: the earlier 'category byte 4' claim was wrong - category 4 routes to 0x425820, the gate is category 3); dispatcher sole caller 0x41CECA (wrapper 0x41CDE0, exchange-keyed, tab packed in {0,1,2}). DOUBLY DEAD: the gate requires byte2==0 but is reachable only at byte2=3 (contradiction), AND the exchange dialog's own packed tab<<16|msg_id with tab in {0,1,2} hits the default no-op in both 0x41CDE0 (only 0x64-0x67) and 0x42D680 (only 3..9). 0x405 never sent in this build. Paint helpers (CORRECTION): 0x46811C sprintf -> 0x45DBA0 set font (0x47BE18, size 0xA) -> 0x45DE50 text rect (x+0x41,y+0x11A)-(x+0x8E,y+0x12B) color 0x64C8F8.

network_gap.bag_fill_entry: CORRECTED (Finding 262): the premise that 'virtual 0x42FC40 is a zero-ref bag-fill entry -> dead or runtime-computed' rests on a MISIDENTIFIED entry point. 0x42FC40 is MID-FUNCTION inside the LIVE bag-fill/replace handler 0x42FC20 (SEH handler 0x475168, ret 0xC28, args [esp+0xC48]=item-record ptr / [esp+0xC44]=slot index). Negative evidence holds ONLY for the exact address 0x42FC40 (0 E8 callers, 0 imm32 refs - it is not a function entry). 0x42FC20 itself has exactly 13 E8 callers: msg handlers 0x41EE9F (msg 0xC8), 0x41F20C+0x41F4DC (msg 0x35), 0x41F63F (msg 0x268), 0x41FDE2 (msg 0x376), 0x42052D+0x4205B8+0x420605 (msg 0x2A9), 0x4206AC (msg 0x2A4), 0x42074F (msg 0x2A5), plus bag-internal 0x42E0C1 (bulk-sync loop: 0x2E=46 records x 0xC2C, per non-empty record copies 0xC20 and calls 0x42FC20 with this=[eax+0x6554]), 0x42FD97 (inside SEH fn ~0x42FD10, handler 0x47518B: 0x42FCC0 get + 0x42FC20 replace = update item at slot), 0x42FF6E (inside small fn 0x42FF30-0x42FF87, ret 8 = replace item). Caller pattern: sub esp,0xC20; mov ecx,0x308; rep movsd (copies 0xC20 bytes from the receive buffer) then call 0x42FC20 with bag this. Body: 0x42F2A0 index_to_rect -> 0x42F280 find-first-free (scans this+0x774+idx*0xC2C, returns idx or -1) -> 0x42F440 record place @0x42FC90; SEH teardown 0x403AC0. Sibling helpers: 0x42FCC0 = get-record at index (reads [this+0x774+idx*0xC2C] occupied flag, rep movsd 0x308 = 0xC20 bytes from rec+0x0C, clears slot via 0x42FB20, returns 1/0; callers 0x42FD69/0x42FE40); 0x42F280 = find first free record. The server->client bag-list reply path is therefore statically RESOLVED as the 0x35/0xC8/0x268/0x376/0x2A9/0x2A4/0x2A5 message handlers feeding 0x42FC20; no runtime packet trace is required to prove the handler exists.
